notes.hook: title promises 'aaj kya sasta mila?' but nothing is said for 43 seconds
notes.what_goes_wrong: A deals video where no price is spoken in 43 seconds of music; if the prices are only in small on-screen text, nobody waits for them.
notes.reusable_pattern: Avoid: 'what's cheap today' reels with no price up front; say the best price in the first 2 seconds.
